items.title: File Widerspruch against reduced dental subsidy decision
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The Widerspruch period is one month and runs from 'Bekanntgabe' (the day the decision counts as delivered). For a letter sent by a Krankenkasse by ordinary post, Bekanntgabe is normally the document date plus the statutory delivery fiction under § 37 SGB X (3-4 days for post), and the one-month period under §§ 187, 188 BGB then runs to the same calendar day of the following month, shifted to the next business day if that day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW. However, this letter carries no printed date (no 'Datum' field anywhere on the page), so the start of the delivery/Bekanntgabe fiction cannot be fixed. Without a known posting date, the exact one-month deadline cannot be computed.
